This implies that the string is non-empty and its first character is '_', so the length is at least 1. Therefore, `beginIndex = 1` is either within the string bounds (if length > 1) or equal to the length (if length == 1), both of which are valid and do not cause an exception. Thus, the only declared exception `IndexOutOfBoundsException` is fully avoided by the preceding check.
